Left foot forward. Right foot back.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight.
strings.하아…. 좀 쉬어야겠다. 다음엔 꼭 붙어야 해, 카르멘. 또 떨어지면 안: Phew... I need a break. You have to pass next time, Carmen. You can't fail again.
Who are you? I got permission to practice dancing here.
strings.그게 아니고, 엠블라가 보내서 왔어요. 카르멘한테 가서 이야기해 보라고: That's not why I'm here. Embla sent me. She said I should talk to Carmen.
strings.엠블라 언니가요? 흠, 무슨 일이지?: Embla did? Hmm, what could it be?
She told me to try a part-time job.
Oh, what a face to make when we've only just met. Give me a moment to compose myself. Ta-da!
Ooooh! %s, I've heard so much about you. They say you're amazing!
I was wondering who those rumors in Glaston were about. It was you, %s! Eee! That's so cool!
strings.나중에 사인 부탁드릴게요. 히히, 저 유명한 분들 사인을 모으는 게 취미: I'll ask for your autograph later. Hehe, collecting famous people's autographs is my hobby.
strings.네, 해드릴게요. 그런데 아르바이트라는 게 어떤 일이죠?: Sure, I'll sign one for you. But what kind of part-time job is this?
strings.지금… 꼭 해야 하나요?: Do we... really have to do it right now?
strings.마을에서 다양한 아르바이트를 해 봤지만, 엠블라 언니의 아르바이트는 늘: I've tried all kinds of part-time jobs around town, but I always have to think twice about Embla's.
It's the most bothersome and the hardest. The hourly pay is pretty good, though.
What on earth does it involve...?
strings.별 건 아니고, 살라르 해안의 소금 결정을 구하는 일이에요. 바닷가에선: Nothing special. We collect salt crystals from the Salar Coast. They look a little pink by the sea, but if you look closely, they're red.
I'm not sure, but they're probably an ingredient for the drinks they make at Ash Tree.
strings.이게 일반적인 소금 결정이 아니라 잘 부서지지 않는 걸 골라야 하는데,: They aren't ordinary salt crystals. You have to pick ones that won't crumble easily, and they're hard to find.
strings.최근에는 어디서 그걸 노리는 귀신 같은 몬스터들이 나타나서 진짜 피곤해요: Lately, these ghostlike monsters have appeared and started going after them. It's exhausting.
Sigh... It wasn't so bad when Askren helped me...
Let's go together. It'll be fine.
strings.정말요? 히히, 좋아요. 그러면 절 따라오세요♬: Really? Hehe, great. Then follow me! ♬
You can find salt crystals on the stretch of sand from here all the way over there.
I don't see any monsters right now.
strings.그렇지만 저쪽에 발을 내딛는 순간부터 두둥, 하고 몬스터가 정신없이 나타: But the moment you set foot over there, bam! They'll start appearing like crazy.
strings.저쪽에서 몬스터가 나타난다면 여기도 위험하지 않나요?: If monsters appear over there, isn't it dangerous here too?
strings.저도 그렇게 생각해서 저번에 아스크렌 오빠하고 확인해 봤는데, 이상하게도: I thought so too, so Askren and I checked last time. Strangely, they never come this far.
It did feel like they were looking for something besides salt crystals, but I'm not sure.
Phew, let me catch my breath. I'm a little nervous.
I had a hard time getting away last time...
strings.매우 불안한 것 같은데…, 저 혼자 다녀올게요. 카르멘은 여기서 기다리고: You seem really anxious... I'll go by myself. Wait here, Carmen.
This is something Embla asked me to do. I'll handle it.
Then let me tell you how to get the salt crystals.
Use the [Dig] skill in front of the red lumps of salt that look like rocks.
strings.운이 좋다면 바로 결정을 얻을 수 있지만, 운이 나쁘면 귀신 같은 몬스터: If you're lucky, you'll get a crystal right away. If you're unlucky, ghostlike monsters will appear and get in your way, %s.
strings.결국 운에 맡겨야 하는군요. 얼마나 가지고 오면 돼요?: So it's down to luck in the end. How many should I bring?
strings.딱 열 개면 돼요. 언니가 욕심내지 말고, 항상 열 개만 가져오라고 했거: Exactly ten. Embla always tells me not to be greedy and to bring back only ten.
All right, Carmen. I'll be back as soon as I can.
strings.벌써요? 와아아, 너무 대단하신데요? 아스크렌 오빠도 빠르다고 생각했는데: Already? Woooow, you're incredible! I thought Askren was fast...
strings.보고만 있어도 말이 안 나올 정도예요. 와아…. 게다가 소금 결정 상태도: I'm speechless just watching you. Wow... And the salt crystals are in amazing condition!
strings.아하하…. 이제 마을로 돌아갈까요?: Ahaha... Shall we head back to town?
I thought someone was there. It might just be my imagination...
strings.누가 있다고요? 여기에는 지금 우리 둘 밖에 없잖아요…. 설마 귀신?: Someone's here? But we're the only two people here right now... Don't tell me it's a ghost?
Th-There aren't any of those here.
strings.으아아아, %s 님. 정말 귀신이 있는 것 같잖아요!: Aaaah, %s! Now it really feels like there's a ghost!
I wasn't trying to scare you.
Aaah, I can't hear you! Th-There's no such thing as ghooosts!
Ahaha, all right. Let's head back quickly, then.
strings.(기분 탓이라고 하기엔 뭔가 이상해. 살라르 해안 주변에 분명 뭔가가 있: (Something feels too strange to dismiss as my imagination. There is definitely something around the Salar Coast...)
strings.(카르멘과 모험가가 떠난 후, 멀리 절벽 위에서 실루엣처럼 보이는 홀로그: (After Carmen and the adventurer leave, a silhouette-like hologram rises from the ground atop a distant cliff.)
strings.「살라르 해안에 대상 에너지 감지되나 확인되지 않음.」: 「Target energy detected on the Salar Coast. Location unconfirmed.」
strings.「바다, 바닷속에서 대상 에너지 감지….」: 「Target energy detected in the sea... underwater...」
Hah, hah... It's been a while since I ran flat out. I'm out of breath.
No one is chasing us, so you can relax.
Phewww. Okay, I'll relax. Thank you for your hard work, %s.
It went well thanks to you, Carmen.
Oh, it was nothing. I'll take the salt crystals to Embla.
Carmen, I've been looking everywhere for you. Oh, %s, you're here too.
You mustn't go to the coast.
Yes. Embla asked us to get something.
You should have called me. We've always gone together.
strings.(아스크렌, 줄곧 모래 사장을 살펴본 건가…?): (Has Askren been keeping an eye on the beach all this time...?)
strings.아무리 찾아도 사제님이 있어야 말이지. %s 님이 도와주셨으니까 오늘은: I looked everywhere, but a certain priest was nowhere to be found. %s helped me, so I won't be going out again today anyway.
strings.이렇게 큰 꼬맹이가 어디 있어!: Who are you calling little? Look how tall I am!
strings.후우, 아스크렌 오빠랑 말장난할 기운도 없어. 그럼 나 엠블라 언니에게: Phew, I don't even have the energy to trade jokes with you, Askren. I'm going to see Embla. Then I have to practice again.
strings.(카르멘이 소금 결정을 안고 엠블라가 있는 곳으로 발걸음을 옮긴다.): (Carmen gathers up the salt crystals and heads toward Embla.)
strings.아스크렌. 전에 도울 일이 있으면 돕겠다고 했었죠?: Askren. I said before that I would help if there was anything I could do, right?
strings.모래사장 쪽에 뭔가 있는 거죠? 카르멘과 함께 다녔던 이유가 단순히 도와: There is something on the beach, isn't there? You weren't going with Carmen simply to help her...
strings.거기 뭔가가 있기 때문이죠?: It was because something is there, right?
Would you follow me for a moment? There are too many eyes here.
strings.여긴 절 보겠다고 모여드는 사람들이 없군요. 이제 말씀드려도 될 것 같습: No crowds gathering to look at me here. I think I can speak now.
Haha, did that bother you? Then I'll get straight to the point.
The reason I kept accompanying Carmen to the beach...
Was that I sensed the energy of ancient ruins.
strings.호드미스 교단 사제인 제 임무는 고대 유적을 찾고 발견한 유물을 교단으로: As a priest of the Hodmis Order, my duty is to find ancient ruins, bring any artifacts we discover to the Order, and decipher them.
strings.고고학자와 비슷한 일을 하시는군요: So your work is rather like an archaeologist's.
strings.조금 다릅니다. 고고학자가 유물과 유적을 통해 과거를 되돌아보는 사람이라: A little different. An archaeologist looks back at the past through artifacts and ruins. As a priest, I cover them up so they do not resurface.
strings.교단의 기준에서 뒤틀린 자와 마족의 힘이 깃들어 위험하다고 판단한 것들을: We seal away or destroy things the Order judges dangerous because they contain the power of the Twisted One or demons.
strings.현재 살라르 해안에 고대 유적의 기운이 엄청나게 몰려 있습니다. 그게 어: An enormous amount of energy from ancient ruins is gathering on the Salar Coast. I cannot say exactly what kind, but it is extremely dangerous.
So that sense of deja vu I felt...
I cannot be certain, but it was most likely caused by that energy.
strings.해안 가득 풍기는 기운은 황혼 시절의 느낌이 강하지만, 모래사장에 나타난: The energy filling the coast feels strongly of the Twilight era, but the monsters appearing on the beach seem to be types from the time of the Chaotic Sky.
The Creed clan and the Silvaria Empire's knights who vanished back then...
strings.후우, 제가 알아 본 바는 이 정도입니다. 도움이 되셨나요?: Phew, that is all I have learned. Was it helpful?
Of course. I'll need to investigate further, but this seems like an important lead.
strings.지금 들으신 건 절대 외부엔 비밀입니다. 오직 여신님을 따르는 %s 님에: What you just heard must remain strictly confidential. This information is entrusted only to you, %s, as a follower of the goddess.
I am sure it will not happen, but if it were to leak outside...
strings.이 이야기는 하지 않는 게 좋겠군요. 끔찍한 상상을 입 밖으로 꺼내는 건: Perhaps I should stop there. Voicing terrible imaginings is not to my taste. Hehe.
The rest is a secret. A priest with secrets has a certain charm, don't you think? Hehe. I'll go see Embla now. Until next time.
